controle-dentaire-meyrin.title: Dental check-up in Meyrin | Examination and prevention
controle-dentaire-meyrin.desc: Dental check-up in Meyrin to examine teeth, gums, restorations and hygiene. Frequency and examinations adapted to each situation.
controle-dentaire-meyrin.h1: What does the dentist check during a dental check-up?
controle-dentaire-meyrin.lead: During a check-up, the dentist examines the teeth, the restorations, the gums, your hygiene and the signs you have noticed. X-rays are only suggested when they provide information that is needed. How often you come back depends on your oral health.

sections.h: What is examined?
p: The dentist starts with your questions, recent changes and any symptoms. They then examine the teeth, old restorations, gums, deposits and, when it concerns your situation, the way your teeth meet.
A check-up can spot a change before it causes discomfort. It can also confirm that an area simply needs to be monitored.

sections.h: Are X-rays systematic?
p: No. The dentist suggests them when they show information that the examination alone cannot reach. The type of image and its timing depend on the clinical question.
Previous images, past treatments and the level of risk are taken into account. The team explains the reason for the examination proposed.

sections.h: When should you come back?
p: The interval is not the same for everyone. It depends in particular on your history, cavities, gums, restorations, hygiene and certain health factors.
At the end of the check-up, the dentist tells you what comes next: no treatment, monitoring, a hygiene appointment or a treatment to plan. The options are explained before the decision.

sections.h: Would you like to take stock?
p: The appointment is there to examine your mouth and tell you what comes next.

faq: Should I wait until it hurts to come in?
No. Some changes do not cause pain straight away and can be spotted during a check-up.
Does the check-up include scaling?
They are two separate procedures. The need for a hygiene appointment is decided according to the deposits and the gums.
What should I tell the dentist?
Mention your symptoms, changes in your health, your medicines and any treatment received since the last appointment.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Frequency and further examinations are adapted to what is observed. Updated 25 August 2026.

carie-dentaire-meyrin.title: Cavities in Meyrin | Diagnosis and treatment
carie-dentaire-meyrin.desc: Cavities in Meyrin: possible signs, diagnosis, treatment and prevention explained before the care.
carie-dentaire-meyrin.lead: The dentist examines the tooth, assesses how far the decay has spread and removes the affected tissue when necessary. The tooth is then restored if it can be kept. If the decay is close to or inside the pulp, a root canal treatment may be discussed.

sections.h: Does a cavity always cause symptoms?
p: No. A cavity may not hurt at first. Sensitivity to cold, heat or sugar, discomfort when chewing, a hole or pain can appear as it progresses, but these signs also have other possible causes.
Pain that fades does not prove the problem is solved. The diagnosis depends on examining the tooth.

sections.h: How does the dentist confirm a cavity?
p: The dentist asks what you feel, examines the tooth and carries out the necessary checks. An X-ray may be suggested if it can show a hidden area between teeth or under an old repair.
They also look at why the cavity may have appeared and whether it is approaching the living part inside the tooth.

sections.h: What treatment is proposed?
p: When the tooth can be restored, the affected tissue is removed and the shape rebuilt with a suitable material. The remaining volume, the position and the forces at play guide the type of restoration.
If the decay has reached the pulp, a root canal treatment may be needed. A very weakened tooth may then need wider protection, such as a crown, depending on the examination.

sections.h: Is a tooth sensitive or painful?
p: The appointment is there to find the cause and the appropriate treatment.

faq: Can a cavity be stopped without treatment?
When it is only just starting, an area can sometimes be monitored with preventive measures. Once a hole has formed, the tooth generally needs to be treated.
Why can a cavity come back?
A new cavity can form near an old repair if the causes that favoured it are still present. Follow-up therefore also covers hygiene and habits.
What should I do in case of severe pain?
Call the practice to have the tooth checked. If swelling makes breathing difficult or the situation is life-threatening, call 144.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. The treatment depends on the depth of the decay and the state of the tooth. Updated 25 August 2026.

traitement-racine-meyrin.title: Root canal treatment in Meyrin | Cabinet Dentaire
traitement-racine-meyrin.desc: Root canal treatment in Meyrin to treat the inside of an affected tooth. Symptoms, steps and restoration after the treatment.
traitement-racine-meyrin.h1: When is a root canal treatment necessary?
traitement-racine-meyrin.lead: This treatment may be proposed when the living part inside a tooth is affected but the tooth can still be kept. The dentist cleans and disinfects the small canals inside the roots, then seals them. Each step is explained before it starts.

sections.h: Why does the inside of a tooth need treating?
p: Deep decay, a crack or a knock can reach the living part at the centre of the tooth. The signs vary, and the tooth does not always hurt. The examination is there to understand the cause and check whether the tooth can still be kept.
The aim of the treatment is to keep your tooth whenever that remains possible. If it is too weakened, the dentist explains the other options.

sections.h: How does a root canal treatment go?
p: The dentist opens an access to the inside of the tooth, removes the affected part, cleans the canals and seals them. Depending on the tooth and the difficulty of the treatment, one or several appointments may be needed. If a highly specialised treatment is preferable, the dentist explains this and refers you to a colleague.

sections.h: Why does the tooth need restoring afterwards?
p: A treated tooth may have lost a significant part of its structure. A filling, a rebuild or a crown may be proposed to protect it, depending on the tooth and what remains of it. This step is part of the plan explained before the end of the treatment.

sections.h: Is a tooth hurting?
p: An examination looks for the cause and checks whether the tooth can be kept.

faq: Is a root canal done in one session?
Sometimes, but several sessions may be needed depending on the tooth, its anatomy and the situation.
Does the pain disappear immediately?
How things evolve depends on the cause and the treatment carried out. The practice tells you what to expect and when to call back.
Is a crown needed after the treatment?
Not always. The restoration depends on the tooth and how much structure remains.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Additional source: SSO Geneva, root canal treatments. Updated 25 August 2026.

dentiste-enfant-meyrin.title: Children's dentist in Meyrin | Cabinet Dentaire
dentiste-enfant-meyrin.desc: Children's dentist in Meyrin for a first check-up, prevention and routine care. Appointments with Victor Palmen or Cilien Prieu.
dentiste-enfant-meyrin.h1: What happens at a dental appointment for a child?
dentiste-enfant-meyrin.lead: The first appointment is there to get to know each other, check the teeth and gums, then talk about habits at home. The dentist explains each step with words suited to the child's age. If treatment is needed, the plan is presented to the parents before deciding what comes next.

sections.h: What does the first check-up look at?
p: The dentist looks at the teeth, the gums, tooth eruption and the habits that can influence oral health. This appointment also gives the child time to see the chair and the instruments without starting with a complex treatment.
An early check-up does not mean treatment will be needed. Above all it spots a need and gives advice suited to the age.

sections.h: How can cavities be prevented in children?
p: Prevention relies on brushing, diet and check-ups adapted to the child's risk. The practice shows the areas to watch and answers questions about the daily routine at home.
The advice can change with age, independence and the state of the teeth. The appointment therefore gives a personal recommendation rather than one rule for every family.

sections.h: What happens when treatment is needed?
p: The dentist explains what was observed, what the treatment aims to fix and how it may unfold. The pace takes the child and the clinical situation into account. When several steps are needed, they are presented to the parents before starting.

sections.h: How should you talk about the appointment at home?
p: Use simple, neutral words, without promising that nothing will happen and without describing an experience that is not the child's. You can say that the dentist will count and look at the teeth, then explain each step.

sections.h: Would you like to plan a first check-up?
p: Give the child's age and the reason for the appointment when booking.

faq: At what age should the first appointment take place?
An early check-up gives you advice from the first teeth. Call the practice if you are unsure about the right time for your child.
Can a parent stay with the child?
The arrangement is explained at the appointment and adapted to the age, the child's needs and the planned care.
What if the child is in pain?
Call the practice and describe the pain, when it started and any other symptoms. The team will tell you what to do next.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. The advice depends on the child's age and oral health. Updated 25 August 2026.

urgence-dentaire-meyrin.title: Dental emergency in Meyrin | Cabinet Dentaire
urgence-dentaire-meyrin.desc: Pain, broken tooth or swelling in Meyrin. Call Cabinet Dentaire Meyrin to describe the situation and find out what to do.
urgence-dentaire-meyrin.h1: What to do in a dental emergency in Meyrin?
urgence-dentaire-meyrin.lead: Severe pain, a broken tooth, swelling or a dental injury need to be assessed. Call Cabinet Dentaire Meyrin on +41 22 320 19 19 and describe the symptoms, when they started and how they are evolving. The team will tell you what to do based on what you describe.

sections.h: When should you call the practice?
p: Contact the practice when pain becomes hard to bear, when a tooth breaks, when swelling appears or when a knock affects a tooth. The degree of urgency cannot be determined from a web page, because it depends on the symptoms, the examination and sometimes an X-ray.
Difficulty breathing, loss of consciousness or uncontrollable bleeding are matters for the emergency services. In Switzerland, call 144 immediately.

sections.h: What to do while waiting for the appointment?
p: Avoid applying any product directly to the tooth or gum without professional advice. In case of bleeding after a procedure or a knock, follow the instructions received from the practice. If symptoms change or get worse, call again so the situation can be reassessed.
For an injury, say on the phone when the knock happened and whether a tooth moved, broke or came out of its socket. These details help the team prepare the consultation.

sections.h: How does an emergency consultation go?
p: The dentist starts by identifying the likely source of the problem and checking the tissues concerned. The first aim may be to relieve, stabilise the situation or protect the tooth. If further treatment is needed, the options and next steps are explained before deciding.
An emergency therefore does not always lead to a complete treatment on the same day. What is done depends on the examination and on what can be done in good conditions.

faq: When should I call for a dental emergency?
Call in case of severe pain, a broken tooth, swelling, injury or bleeding that worries you. Describe the symptoms precisely on the phone.
Does the practice see patients without an appointment?
Call before coming. The team can tell you when to come depending on the situation and availability.
What should I do outside opening hours?
Follow the instructions on the practice's answering machine or contact the on-call service of the SSO Geneva. In a life-threatening emergency, call 144.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Additional source: SSO Geneva, what to do in a dental emergency. Updated 25 August 2026.

hygieniste-dentaire-meyrin.title: Dental hygienist in Meyrin | Scaling and gums
hygieniste-dentaire-meyrin.desc: Dental hygienist in Meyrin for scaling, hygiene and gum care. Appointments with Juliana at Cabinet Dentaire Meyrin.
hygieniste-dentaire-meyrin.h1: What is a dental hygienist appointment for?
hygieniste-dentaire-meyrin.lead: This appointment removes the tartar and deposits that brushing cannot, looks at the state of the gums and shows you the right technique for your mouth. How often you come back depends on what is observed at the check-up.

sections.h: What does scaling remove?
p: Tartar is a mineralised deposit that clings to the teeth and cannot be removed by ordinary brushing. The hygiene appointment removes it, cleans the areas concerned and identifies where deposits come back.
The appointment does not replace daily habits. It allows them to be adjusted, for brushing or cleaning between the teeth for instance, according to what is observed.

sections.h: Why do gums bleed?
p: Repeated bleeding can go with gum inflammation. The examination looks for plaque, tartar and other signs that guide the care. The treatment may include professional cleaning and precise advice for the difficult areas.
Bleeding does not have a single possible cause. If it persists, it is better to have it checked than to change your habits alone or stop brushing.

sections.h: How often should you plan a check?
p: There is no interval that fits everyone. The frequency depends on your gums, how fast tartar comes back and the treatments already carried out. The team suggests a rhythm after looking at your situation.

sections.h: Would you like to book a scaling?
p: The appointment cleans the deposits and checks the gums.

faq: Does scaling whiten the teeth?
It removes deposits and some surface staining, but it is not teeth whitening.
Can the appointment be sensitive?
Sensitivity varies with the gums and the deposits. Say what you feel so the care can be adapted.
Should I come in if my gums bleed when brushing?
Yes, when bleeding comes back regularly, a check looks for the cause and suggests the right technique.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Additional source: SSO Geneva, dental prevention. Updated 25 August 2026.

detartrage-meyrin.title: Scaling in Meyrin | Dental hygiene
detartrage-meyrin.desc: Scaling in Meyrin to remove tartar, check the gums and adjust your hygiene routine with the dental hygienist.
detartrage-meyrin.lead: Scaling removes tartar, a mineralised deposit that clings to the teeth and does not come off with brushing. The appointment also looks at the gums, identifies where deposits come back and adjusts your hygiene routine. How often depends on your situation.

sections.h: What is the difference between plaque and tartar?
p: Plaque is a deposit that forms again on the teeth and can be removed with a suitable hygiene routine. When part of it mineralises, it becomes tartar and stays attached to the tooth surface.
Tartar can sit above or below the edge of the gum. Its quantity and location are not the same for everyone.

sections.h: What happens during the appointment?
p: The hygienist looks at the deposits and the gums, then removes the tartar with the appropriate instruments. She can also clean some surface staining and show how to reach the difficult areas.
Mention any sensitivity during the treatment. The procedure can be adjusted according to the gums and the amount of deposits.

sections.h: How often should scaling be planned?
p: There is no interval that fits everyone. The frequency depends on how fast tartar comes back, the state of the gums and the treatments already carried out.
After the check, the hygienist tells you when to come back. Scaling completes the daily routine but does not replace it.

sections.h: Would you like to book a scaling?
p: The appointment removes the deposits and checks the gums.

faq: Does scaling damage the enamel?
The treatment targets the deposits on the tooth. The hygienist adapts the instruments and method to what is observed.
Why do teeth sometimes look more spaced out afterwards?
When tartar filled a space, removing it can make that space more visible. It does not mean the treatment created the gap.
Should I come in if my gums bleed?
Bleeding that comes back deserves a check to find the cause and suggest the right care.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Additional source: SSO Geneva, dental prevention. Updated 25 August 2026.

soins-gencives-meyrin.title: Gum care in Meyrin | Bleeding and follow-up
soins-gencives-meyrin.desc: Gums that bleed or stay sensitive? Examination, cleaning and gum follow-up at Cabinet Dentaire Meyrin.
soins-gencives-meyrin.h1: What to do when gums bleed?
soins-gencives-meyrin.lead: Repeated bleeding can go with gum inflammation, often when plaque or tartar is present. Simply avoiding the area is not the answer. A check looks for the cause, cleans the deposits if needed and shows you the right technique.

sections.h: Which signs deserve a check?
p: Frequent bleeding, redness, swelling, sensitivity, persistent bad breath or a change around a tooth can justify an appointment. Pain is not always present.
These signs do not have a single cause. The check distinguishes a local irritation, an inflammation linked to deposits and other situations that need different care.

sections.h: How are the gums examined?
p: The professional looks at the colour, the outline, the deposits and the bleeding. Certain areas around the teeth may be measured, and further examinations requested when they provide useful information.
They also check your hygiene routine and the factors that make some areas hard to clean. The explanation starts from what is really observed in your mouth.

sections.h: How do the treatment and follow-up go?
p: The treatment may combine professional cleaning and a daily routine adapted to the areas concerned. Depending on the extent, several appointments or a check after the initial phase may be proposed.
The follow-up checks how the gums respond and adjusts the frequency of appointments. An improvement does not remove the need for daily care.

sections.h: Do your gums bleed regularly?
p: The appointment is there to find the cause and suggest the right care.

faq: Is a bleeding gum necessarily diseased?
Bleeding can go with inflammation, but an examination is needed to understand its cause.
Is a mouthwash enough?
It does not remove tartar and does not replace brushing or cleaning between the teeth. The team tells you whether it can help in your situation.
How often should I come back?
The frequency depends on the state of your gums and how they respond to treatment.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Additional source: SSO Geneva, dental prevention. Updated 25 August 2026.

implant-dentaire-meyrin.title: Dental implant in Meyrin | Cabinet Dentaire
implant-dentaire-meyrin.desc: Dental implant in Meyrin to replace one or several teeth. Indications, steps, implant or bridge and consultation with Edouard Di Donna.
implant-dentaire-meyrin.h1: Dental implant in Meyrin: indications, steps and alternatives
implant-dentaire-meyrin.lead: A dental implant replaces the root of a missing tooth and can support a crown or a prosthesis. The decision depends on the tooth to replace, the state of the gums, the bone available and your general health. A consultation compares the implant with a bridge or a removable solution.

sections.h: When can an implant be considered?
p: An implant can be studied when a tooth is missing or cannot be kept. The examination covers the area to treat, the neighbouring teeth, the gums and the bone volume. Health habits and certain conditions can also change the plan or the timeline.
A gap therefore does not mean an implant is automatically indicated. The project has to take the whole mouth into account and the way the future tooth will be used.

sections.h: How does the treatment go?
p: The first consultation clarifies the need and gathers the necessary examinations. If the implant is chosen, its placement is planned. A healing period may be needed before the prosthetic tooth is made. The number of appointments and the timeline vary with the clinical situation.
Before starting, the practice explains the steps, the alternatives and the expected follow-up. An estimate depends on the chosen plan and cannot be given reliably without an examination.

sections.h: Implant or bridge: how to compare?
p: An implant rests on the bone, whereas a bridge generally rests on neighbouring teeth. The bridge can make sense in some situations, in particular when the neighbouring teeth already need restoring. The implant can avoid using them as supports, but it requires a surgical assessment.

The right choice therefore depends on the state of the neighbouring teeth, the bone, the gums, the treatment time and the patient's preferences. The comparison is made on those criteria, not on a solution presented as better in every case.

sections.h: How to replace several teeth?
p: Several missing teeth can be replaced by a fixed or removable prosthesis, sometimes supported by implants. The number of implants is not necessarily the same as the number of teeth replaced. The plan depends on the distribution of supports and the functional aim.
A consultation separates what belongs to surgery from what belongs to prosthetics, then organises the steps in the right order.

sections.h: Would you like to replace a tooth?
p: A first consultation compares the possible solutions.

faq: Can an implant be placed when bone is lacking?
The quantity and quality of bone are assessed before the decision. Depending on the situation, bone preparation may be discussed or another solution proposed.
Is placing an implant painful?
The procedure and its aftermath are explained before the treatment. Perception varies with the procedure and the person, so the practitioner details the measures adapted to your situation.
How much does a dental implant cost?
The cost depends on the examinations, the surgery, the prosthesis and any additional procedures. An individual estimate is drawn up after the assessment.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. The implant plan depends on a clinical examination and the indicated tests. Updated 25 August 2026.

chirurgie-orale-meyrin.title: Oral surgery in Meyrin | Cabinet Dentaire
chirurgie-orale-meyrin.desc: Oral surgery in Meyrin for extractions, wisdom teeth and implantology. Consultation with Edouard Di Donna at Cabinet Dentaire Meyrin.
chirurgie-orale-meyrin.h1: Why might an oral surgery procedure be proposed?
chirurgie-orale-meyrin.lead: Oral surgery covers in particular certain extractions, wisdom teeth and procedures linked to implants. A procedure is proposed when an examination shows that a surgical step answers the problem and the other options are not suitable. The practitioner explains the indication, the steps and the follow-up before your decision.

sections.h: Which treatments belong to oral surgery?
p: The field includes simple or more complex extractions, the assessment and extraction of wisdom teeth, and surgery linked to implants. The need is not deduced from an isolated symptom. It rests on the history of the problem, the clinical examination and the images judged necessary.
A tooth can sometimes be kept or treated differently. The role of the consultation is also to check that possibility before planning a procedure.

sections.h: How is a procedure prepared?
p: The practitioner details the planned step, the useful examinations, the instructions before the appointment and the usual aftermath. They take into account the medicines, history and allergies reported by the patient.
The course and the risks depend on the procedure. They are therefore explained for your situation, with the available alternatives and the reasons for the proposed choice.

sections.h: What happens after the procedure?
p: Written or spoken instructions cover hygiene, food, taking the prescribed medicines and the signs that should lead you to call the practice. The check-up schedule depends on the procedure carried out and on healing.
If pain or bleeding evolves in a way that worries you, contact the practice. In case of difficulty breathing or a life-threatening situation, call 144.

sections.h: Does a procedure need assessing?
p: The consultation confirms the indication and explains the options.

faq: Is an extraction always necessary when a tooth hurts?
No. Pain can have several causes. The examination determines whether the tooth can be treated or whether an extraction should be discussed.
Is an X-ray needed?
An image is suggested when it provides information needed for the decision or to prepare the procedure.
How much time should I allow?
The length of the procedure and of healing varies with the step and the situation. The practitioner gives you an estimate after the assessment.

dents-sagesse-meyrin.title: Wisdom teeth in Meyrin | Cabinet Dentaire
dents-sagesse-meyrin.desc: Pain or infection linked to wisdom teeth in Meyrin. Assessment, indication for extraction and follow-up at Cabinet Dentaire Meyrin.
dents-sagesse-meyrin.h1: When should you see a dentist about a wisdom tooth?
dents-sagesse-meyrin.lead: A wisdom tooth does not always need to be extracted. A consultation is indicated when it causes pain, swelling, gum inflammation or when a check-up shows a problem of position or space. The decision to keep or extract rests on the clinical examination and, if needed, on an X-ray.

sections.h: Which signs should lead you to come in?
p: A wisdom tooth can stay silent or cause inflammation of the gum covering it. Pain at the back of the mouth, swelling, discomfort when opening, a persistent bad taste or repeated episodes justify an assessment.
In case of progressive swelling, fever or difficulty swallowing or breathing, contact a professional quickly. Difficulty breathing is a matter for 144.

sections.h: How is the decision to keep or extract made?
p: The practitioner assesses the position of the tooth, how easily it can be cleaned, the space available, the state of the gum and its relationship with neighbouring structures. An X-ray may be needed to see what the examination cannot reach.
A well positioned tooth with no problem can be monitored. An extraction may be discussed when symptoms, infections or local risks justify it.

sections.h: How is the extraction prepared?
p: The preliminary appointment explains the procedure, the instructions and the expected aftermath. The practitioner takes your treatments, history and allergies into account. After the procedure, follow the instructions received and call the practice if the evolution worries you.

sections.h: Is a wisdom tooth bothering you?
p: The consultation looks for the cause and decides what comes next.

faq: Do all four wisdom teeth need removing?
Not necessarily. Each tooth is assessed according to its position and the problem observed.
Can a wisdom tooth cause an emergency?
Yes, inflammation or infection around the tooth can become painful. Call the practice to describe the symptoms.
Can I work after an extraction?
Getting back to work depends on the procedure, the aftermath and your activity. The practitioner gives you a suitable recommendation after the assessment.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Additional source: SSO Geneva, wisdom teeth. Updated 25 August 2026.

extraction-dentaire-meyrin.title: Tooth extraction in Meyrin | Procedure and aftermath
extraction-dentaire-meyrin.desc: Tooth extraction in Meyrin: indications, preparation, aftermath and replacement of the tooth explained before the procedure.
extraction-dentaire-meyrin.h1: When is a tooth extraction necessary?
extraction-dentaire-meyrin.lead: An extraction is considered when a tooth cannot be kept or when it causes a problem that cannot be treated otherwise. The dentist first checks the possibilities of keeping it, explains the procedure and prepares the aftermath, including replacement if indicated.

sections.h: Why might a tooth need removing?
p: Very extensive decay, a fracture, an infection, a gum problem or a poor position can lead to discussing an extraction. Before proposing it, the dentist always checks whether the tooth can still be treated and kept.
They explain what can be kept and the consequences of each choice. A wisdom tooth or a more delicate extraction may need a specific examination.

sections.h: What should be planned before the procedure?
p: The assessment identifies the tooth concerned, its shape, the neighbouring tissues and the necessary examinations. Mention your illnesses, medicines, allergies and any recent change in your health. Do not change a prescribed treatment without the agreement of the professional who follows it.
The anaesthesia, the course of the procedure and the instructions afterwards are explained before the appointment. You can ask your questions before giving your consent.

sections.h: What is the aftermath like?
p: The practice gives instructions adapted to the procedure carried out, in particular to protect the area, for food, hygiene and taking the prescribed medicines. The aftermath is not the same for every extraction.

The signs that should lead you to call back are detailed. Difficulty breathing, loss of consciousness or uncontrollable bleeding require calling 144. Any replacement of the tooth is planned according to healing.

sections.h: Has an extraction been mentioned?
p: The appointment checks the indication and prepares the aftermath.

faq: Does a painful tooth necessarily need removing?
No. Several treatments can keep it depending on the cause. The examination determines what is possible.
Can an implant be prepared before the extraction?
The future solution can be discussed before the procedure. Its timing however depends on the tooth, the tissues and the expected healing.
What if the pain increases after the procedure?
Follow the instructions given and contact the practice if the evolution does not match what was announced or if a warning sign appears.

implant-ou-bridge.title: Implant or bridge in Meyrin | How to choose?
implant-ou-bridge.desc: Implant or bridge to replace a tooth: supports, neighbouring teeth, steps and decision criteria explained at Cabinet Dentaire Meyrin.
implant-ou-bridge.h1: Implant or bridge: how to choose to replace a tooth?
implant-ou-bridge.lead: An implant rests in the bone, whereas a bridge generally rests on the neighbouring teeth. The choice depends on the state of those teeth, the bone, the gums, the timeline and your priorities. There is no solution that is better in every situation.

sections.h: What do the implant and the bridge rest on?
p: The implant is an artificial root placed in the bone. A crown is then fixed on it once healing allows. The neighbouring teeth do not serve as supports.

A conventional bridge links the replacement tooth to adjacent teeth prepared to receive it. It can make sense when those teeth themselves need a restoration. Other types of bridges exist, depending on the area and the forces at play.

sections.h: What does the dentist look at before advising you?
p: For an implant, they check the bone, the gums, the space available and your health. For a bridge, they look at whether the neighbouring teeth are strong enough to serve as supports. How you will be able to clean the area also matters.
The time needed, the cost and what matters to you are part of the discussion. You know the advantages and limits of each solution before choosing.

sections.h: Is the course of treatment different?
p: For an implant, a first procedure places the implant, then the tooth is made after the necessary healing time. A bridge avoids placing an implant but generally uses the neighbouring teeth as supports.
The number of appointments is not enough to decide. The dentist also explains the length of the steps, the maintenance and the care the neighbouring teeth might need.

sections.h: Hesitating between implant and bridge?
p: The appointment compares the two plans starting from your mouth.

faq: Does an implant avoid touching the neighbouring teeth?
It does not use them as supports, but the whole area still has to be assessed before treatment.
Can a bridge replace several teeth?
It can be possible depending on the distribution of the supporting teeth and the forces. The plan depends on the examination.
How can I get comparable estimates?
The dentist must first define the two possible plans, with their steps. The estimates can then be compared on the same need.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. The choice between implant and bridge depends on a clinical examination and the indicated tests. Updated 25 August 2026.

dent-manquante.title: Missing tooth in Meyrin | Which solutions?
dent-manquante.desc: A tooth is missing or needs removing? Compare implant, bridge and removable prosthesis during a dental consultation in Meyrin.
dent-manquante.h1: A tooth is missing: which solutions are possible?
dent-manquante.lead: A missing tooth can be replaced by an implant with a crown, a bridge or a removable prosthesis. The choice depends on the position of the tooth, the state of the neighbouring teeth, the gums, the bone and your priorities. An examination compares these solutions before deciding.

sections.h: What can a missing tooth change?
p: The consequences vary with its position and the way the other teeth meet. A missing tooth can hinder chewing or let the neighbouring teeth drift. In other situations, the inconvenience stays limited.
The dentist looks at the space, the neighbouring teeth and the gums. They also tell you whether the area can simply be monitored without replacing the tooth straight away.

sections.h: How to compare implant, bridge and removable prosthesis?
p: The implant replaces a support in the bone and can hold a crown. The bridge generally rests on the neighbouring teeth. The removable prosthesis is taken out for cleaning and can replace one or several teeth. Each solution requires different conditions.
The comparison covers the available tissues, the teeth that could serve as supports, the course of treatment, the maintenance and the cost. No solution is preferable in every situation.

sections.h: When should the replacement be prepared?
p: If an extraction is planned, it can be useful to talk about the replacement before the procedure. Healing and the future tooth can then be thought through together. If the tooth has been missing for a long time, a consultation is still entirely possible.
The timeline depends on the area and the chosen treatment. The dentist explains the steps and gives you an estimate after the examination.

sections.h: Would you like to replace a tooth?
p: The appointment examines the area and compares the possible solutions.

faq: Does a missing tooth always need replacing?
No. The decision depends on the tooth, its function and the risk of drifting. An examination compares replacement and monitoring.
Can I choose without an X-ray?
The examination starts with the mouth. The dentist then indicates the imaging needed depending on the solution being studied.
Is the price the same for each solution?
No. It depends on the chosen treatment and the associated care. An individual estimate is drawn up after the assessment.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. The solution and the timeline depend on a clinical examination and the indicated tests. Updated 25 August 2026.

remplacer-plusieurs-dents.title: Replacing several teeth in Meyrin | Solutions
remplacer-plusieurs-dents.desc: Fixed or removable solutions to replace several teeth in Meyrin. Supports, implants, steps and maintenance explained before treatment.
remplacer-plusieurs-dents.h1: How to replace several missing teeth?
remplacer-plusieurs-dents.lead: Several missing teeth can be replaced by a fixed or removable solution, supported by the remaining teeth, by implants or by a suitable combination. The number of implants is not necessarily equal to the number of teeth replaced. The examination determines the possible supports.

sections.h: Which fixed solutions can be studied?
p: A bridge can link several replacement teeth to natural teeth or to implants that serve as supports. The distribution depends on the length of the gap, the position of the supports and the chewing forces.
A fixed plan must also allow for cleaning. The dentist explains how to maintain the future prosthesis and checks that this maintenance is possible day to day.

sections.h: When can a removable prosthesis be suitable?
p: A removable prosthesis can replace several teeth with an appliance that is taken out for cleaning. It can use the remaining teeth and the tissues as supports. Its design depends on their distribution.
It may be proposed when the fixed solution is not indicated or does not match the patient's priorities. Fit, stability and maintenance are discussed before it is made.

sections.h: How is the plan established?
p: The dentist looks at the remaining teeth, the gums, the bone, the space available and the way your teeth meet. They tell you which treatments to do first, how the teeth will be replaced and how they will be followed afterwards.
If implants are considered, their number and position depend on the teeth to replace. You receive the explanations and the estimate before starting.

sections.h: Several teeth are missing?
p: The appointment establishes the possible supports and the order of treatments.

faq: Is one implant needed per missing tooth?
Not necessarily. One prosthetic unit can rest on a number of supports defined case by case.
Is a fixed prosthesis always possible?
No. It depends on the teeth or implants usable as supports and on the distribution of forces.
How do I maintain several replaced teeth?
The routine depends on the prosthesis. The team shows how to clean around the supports and under the elements where this applies.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. The supports, the timeline and the prosthesis depend on a clinical examination. Updated 25 August 2026.

couronne-dentaire-meyrin.title: Dental crown in Meyrin | When is it indicated?
couronne-dentaire-meyrin.desc: Dental crown in Meyrin to restore a weakened tooth. Indications, steps, alternatives and maintenance explained before treatment.
couronne-dentaire-meyrin.h1: When can a dental crown be indicated?
couronne-dentaire-meyrin.lead: A crown covers the visible part of a tooth to give it back its shape and protect it when it is very weakened. The dentist looks at what remains of the tooth, its position and the forces it bears before advising you.

sections.h: In which situations is a crown discussed?
p: It may be proposed after extensive decay, a fracture, a large old repair or a root canal treatment. It is not necessary in every case.
The dentist looks at what remains of the tooth, the gums, the root and the forces exerted when chewing. They first check that the tooth can be kept in good conditions.

sections.h: How is it made?
p: The tooth is prepared according to the plan, then an impression or a scan is taken to make the crown. A temporary solution can be planned between the steps. The final crown is then checked and fixed.
The number of appointments and the material depend on the situation. The practice explains the proposed choice and its maintenance before treatment.

sections.h: Which alternatives can be considered?
p: When enough healthy tooth remains, a more limited restoration can sometimes be suitable. Conversely, if the tooth cannot be kept, the plan may have to address its extraction and replacement.
The comparison covers the amount of tissue to preserve, the expected strength, access for cleaning and cost. The choice follows the examination, not a rule that is identical for every tooth.

sections.h: Has a crown been mentioned?
p: The appointment examines the tooth and compares the possible restorations.

faq: Is a crown a false tooth?
It covers a tooth that is kept. On an implant, by contrast, a crown replaces the visible part of a missing tooth.
How long does a crown last?
Its lifespan depends on the tooth, the forces, hygiene and follow-up. An individual figure cannot be promised before treatment.
Can you get a cavity under a crown?
The edge of the restoration and the root still need watching. Brushing, cleaning between the teeth and check-ups remain necessary.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. The type of restoration depends on the tooth and the structure still present. Updated 25 August 2026.

facettes-dentaires-meyrin.title: Veneers in Meyrin | Indications and limits
facettes-dentaires-meyrin.desc: Veneers in Meyrin: indications, limits, preparation and alternatives assessed during a dental check-up.
facettes-dentaires-meyrin.h1: In which cases can veneers be considered?
facettes-dentaires-meyrin.lead: A veneer covers the visible surface of a tooth to change its shape or shade. Before proposing it, the dentist checks the enamel, the gums, the way the teeth meet and the other possible solutions. If the tooth has to be prepared irreversibly, this is explained before any decision.

sections.h: What can a veneer change?
p: A veneer can change the visible appearance of a tooth, in particular its shape, certain proportions or its shade. It does not treat every cause of misalignment, wear or discolouration.
The assessment checks each tooth concerned and the smile as a whole. It also looks for cavities, gum problems and forces that could weaken the result.

sections.h: Which limits should you know?
p: Depending on the situation, the tooth has to be prepared to receive the veneer. This change can be irreversible. The dentist details the volume concerned, the proposed material and the maintenance constraints.
A veneer can come off, wear or fracture. It does not make the tooth immune to cavities or gum problems. Check-ups remain necessary.

sections.h: Which other solutions can meet the need?
p: Whitening can be discussed when the request concerns the shade of natural teeth. A composite restoration can change a more limited area. Orthodontic treatment can act on the position of the teeth.
A crown answers a more heavily weakened tooth, but it covers more structure. The choice depends on the need, the state of the tooth and what can be preserved.

sections.h: Considering veneers?
p: The assessment checks the teeth and compares the possible solutions.

faq: Do veneers replace whitening?
Not necessarily. Whitening acts on the shade of natural teeth, whereas a veneer covers their visible surface.
Can a veneer be placed without removing enamel?
It depends on the tooth and the project. The dentist has to explain the preparation really needed in your case.
How do I clean a veneer?
It needs brushing and cleaning between the teeth, with attention to the edge of the restoration and the gums.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Additional source: SSO Geneva, cosmetic treatments. Updated 25 August 2026.

blanchiment-dentaire-meyrin.title: Teeth whitening in Meyrin | Assessment and treatment
blanchiment-dentaire-meyrin.desc: Teeth whitening in Meyrin after an assessment of the teeth and gums. Expected result, restorations and sensitivity explained.
blanchiment-dentaire-meyrin.h1: What needs checking before teeth whitening?
blanchiment-dentaire-meyrin.lead: Before whitening, the dentist checks the teeth, the gums, any sensitivity and the visible restorations. The treatment changes the shade of natural teeth, but not that of crowns, composites or veneers. This assessment allows a consistent result and a suitable protocol to be planned.

sections.h: Why start with an assessment?
p: A difference in shade can come from surface staining, the natural shade, a restoration or a single tooth. The assessment identifies what can respond to whitening and what needs another approach.
Cavities, gum problems and sensitivity are taken into account before treatment. A hygiene appointment may be advised if deposits mask the shade.

sections.h: What result can be expected?
p: The response varies with the initial shade, the nature of the staining and the teeth. The dentist explains the change the treatment can reasonably aim for, without promising the same shade for everyone.
Crowns, veneers and composite restorations do not lighten like natural teeth. Their presence can influence the order of treatments.

sections.h: How is sensitivity taken into account?
p: Temporary sensitivity can appear during or after whitening. The protocol, the duration and the instructions are adapted to the situation and to what you feel.
If a tooth is already sensitive before treatment, its cause has to be looked for. Whitening does not replace the treatment of a painful tooth.

sections.h: Considering whitening?
p: The assessment checks the teeth and explains the possible result.

faq: Is scaling enough to lighten the teeth?
It removes deposits and some surface staining, but does not change the natural shade the way whitening does.
Is the result permanent?
The shade can change over time and with habits. Follow-up depends on the treatment and the situation.
Can a single tooth be whitened?
An isolated tooth of a different colour first needs a diagnosis. The treatment depends on the cause and on previous care.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Additional source: SSO Geneva, cosmetic dentistry and whitening. Updated 25 August 2026.

esthetique-dentaire-meyrin.title: Whitening and veneers in Meyrin | Cabinet Dentaire
esthetique-dentaire-meyrin.desc: Teeth whitening and veneers in Meyrin. Assessment of teeth and gums, options, limits and a personal treatment plan.
esthetique-dentaire-meyrin.h1: Whitening or veneers: which solution matches your request?
esthetique-dentaire-meyrin.lead: Whitening acts on the shade of natural teeth, whereas veneers cover their visible surface to change the shape, the colour or certain irregularities. Before proposing either, the dentist checks the teeth and gums, then explains the realistic result and the limits of each option.

sections.h: What can teeth whitening change?
p: Whitening aims to lighten the shade of natural teeth. It does not change the colour of crowns, veneers or fillings. The result depends on the starting shade and the cause of the staining.
Sensitivity can occur. The protocol and precautions are therefore chosen after checking the teeth and gums.

sections.h: What are veneers for?
p: A veneer covers the visible face of a tooth. It can change a shape, a shade or an irregularity. Before proposing it, the dentist checks what will have to be changed on the tooth and the way the teeth meet.
A solution that touches the tooth less can sometimes meet your request. The dentist compares the possibilities with you before proposing a treatment.

sections.h: How to choose between the solutions?
p: The choice starts from the change you are looking for and from what is possible without compromising the health of the teeth. Whitening mainly concerns colour, whereas veneers can also change shape. Hygiene care or the restoration of a tooth may need to be done before the cosmetic treatment.

sections.h: Would you like to talk about your smile?
p: The consultation starts from your request and compares the suitable options.

faq: Does whitening work on crowns?
No. Restoration materials do not lighten like natural teeth.
Do veneers require changing the tooth?
It depends on the situation and the type of restoration. The practitioner explains what is planned before any decision.
How long does the result last?
The duration depends on the treatment, habits and maintenance. A more precise estimate is given after the assessment.
notes: This information helps you prepare the appointment. Only an examination can tell which treatment suits you. Additional source: SSO Geneva, cosmetic dentistry and whitening. Updated 25 August 2026.
